fusions.name: Spore-Dusted Rush
fusions.desc: Looses 3 spore-dusted rats at once, each dealing 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Ripe for Gnawing
fusions.desc: Gnaws into one rotting enemy and deals 18 damage, using up every affliction you have on it for 60% more damage each, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rot-Warm Hollow
fusions.desc: Spreads a bed of mould where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Fruiting Bodies
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack of spores on that enemy, up to 6. At 6 they all burst at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
